info.name: Digital Public Library of America (DPLA) Authentication Utilities API

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression to constrain the random selection pool. Format is field:value.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your DPLA API key. Alternatively, pass as Authorization header.

items.docs: Returns a single randomly selected cultural heritage item record. Supports an optional filter parameter to constrain the pool of eligible records.
Returns HTTP 200 OK if the API is operational.
